title: A1: CLI run이 RunResult를 result.json으로 쓰게 함
body: ## 요약 `npx tsx engine/cli.ts run --input --seed --n --out ` 가 `/result.json` 을 `RunResult` 로 씁니다. 메인에 엔진과 `shared/` 가 빠져 있어 루프가 컴파일되지 않았습니다. `88b3616` 의 엔진을 되돌린 뒤 아래 계약을 맞췄습니다. - `designs[]` 와 `results[]` 길이가 같고, 제약 위반(`constraintsOk=false`)도 결과에서 빠지지 않습니다. - `50 <= n <= 1000` 이면 통과한 변형은 시뮬레이트된 `months[]` 를 유지합니다. 생존은 36개월, 사망은 사망 월까지입니다. - `leaderDesignId`, `cliff.relativeDelta`, `status`(StatusBar: runId, inputFiles, inputHash 8자, engineSha, endState, replay, tokens, tokenTotal, gateLog)를 채웁니다. - 초기 지출(outlay)은 보증금 + 인테리어비뿐입니다. 장비비, 월세, 인건비는 빼지 않습니다. - 2025–2026 분기 6개는 `shared/` 에서 빼 `data/holdoutQuarters.ts` 로 옮겼습니다. 파라미터 적합은 2021–2024만 봅니다. ## 확인 `npm test` 17개 통과 (엔진 AT, 루프 AT, `engine/cli.contract.test.ts`). CLI 테스트는 위 명령을 `n=50`, seed 42, 위반 설계 1건으로 실행합니다. ## 계약에서 문서로 닫히지 않은 점 `tests/README.md` 의 "CLI contract" 절은 저장소와 git 이력에 없습니다. 이번 구현은 요청 항목과 기존 `RunResult` / `StatusBar` 타입을 기준으로 했습니다. 그 README가 나중에 생기면 그 문서가 우선입니다. - SPEC §5는 초기 현금에서 장비비도 빼라고 합니다. 요청과 기존 엔진은 보증금+인테리어만 지출로 봅니다. 장비비는 설계 필드로는 남고 초기 현금에는 들어가지 않습니다. - SPEC은 홀드아웃을 `tests/holdout` 에 두라고 합니다. 분기 행은 `data/holdoutQuarters.ts` 에 두었습니다. `shared/` 타입의 게이트 이름 `holdout` 과 `holdoutErrorPp` 필드는 상태바 계약이라 남겨 두었습니다. 분기 코드(20251–20262, 2025Q1–2026Q2)는 `shared/` 에 없습니다. - `--n` 은 생성할 설계 수입니다. 입력의 `injectedDesigns` 는 뒤에 붙으므로 `designs.length` 는 `n + 주입 수` 일 수 있습니다. 입력에 `designs` 배열이 있으면 길이가 `--n` 과 같아야 하고 그 배열을 그대로 씁니다. - `n > 1000` 이면 월별 행은 표본과 1위 설계만 남깁니다. 1만 개 전부에 36개월 행을 쓰면 페이로드가 SPEC의 1MB 한도를 넘습니다. - `run` 은 입력에 `runAdversarial: true` 가 없으면 적대 라운드를 돌리지 않습니다. `rounds` 는 `[]` 입니다. - 이 경로는 모델을 호출하지 않으므로 `status.tokens` 는 빈 배열이고 합계는 0입니다.

title: A Thousand Stores: 10,000-candidate Cloud rehearsal and English submission packet
body:
The runnable workbench previously used 1,000 local presets even though the specification required 10,000. This PR makes 500 preset seed families × 20 deterministic variations the default, fixes duplicate IDs/zero-value/leader-ledger defects, and connects the six-screen A3 client to the validated server API with fresh decisions and original CSV/JSON/Markdown evidence exports.

Google Cloud preview: https://thousand-stores-wva46uzo7a-du.a.run.app/rehearsal/

Deployment: participant-approved project `h2gdm-hack26icn-2637`, service `thousand-stores`, revision `thousand-stores-00001-hzn`, deployed source `552b5dcde7d01c519029173559664d92a7b6a535`. Unauthenticated health, real 10,000-candidate execution and desktop/mobile UI passed 13 actual Cloud checks. The preview has no Gemini key configured.

Validation:
- Build/type checks and 126 active unit/HTTP checks pass; seven fixed external arithmetic cases pass without claiming a full independent oracle.
- Actual local Chrome: 20 checks pass, including original downloads, leader-ledger/canvas agreement, zero-demand boundaries, input/in-flight freshness, blocked AI and 390px layout.
- Actual Cloud: one preview POST returned DONE with 10,000 unique IDs and the correct source SHA; 13 checks pass. Its resource duration was 4,189.3 ms after initial GET checks, not a cold-start/percentile or two-second-path claim.
- A 147.113-second local captured-screen montage with English narration and captions is prepared and saved privately to Library. It is not continuous live interaction, live AI execution or Cloud proof. No public video upload or final event submission was performed.
- English project description, README, field sheet, checklist, scripts, Q&A, recording narration and verification summary are in docs/. The reviewed documentation revision is ccafd8a. Organizer requirements supplied by the participant: Google Cloud, English and 15:20 KST deadline.

The bounded server-only Gemini adapter requests 5×100 validated families with concurrency/time/response/call limits; only complete valid responses and measured usage permit the AI-family label. Provider I/O was mocked in tests. Live model calls: 0. Financial calibration/hidden holdout, full independent ledger coverage and AI-versus-random advantage remain unverified; business acceptance gates are preserved. Sensitivity intervals are checked at full-population endpoints but are not claimed to be globally minimal or exact boundaries. Raw public datasets, shared types and protected verifier tests/fixtures are unchanged.

User decision remains **PR only: do not merge main**. No final submission, messages, email or new automation was sent.

Base main advanced during submission preparation. The PR is currently conflicting with that newer main; the reviewed submission branch and deployed SHA above remain pinned. No merge was attempted.

title: [Reference] Verified cafe cashflow workbench for lane integration
body:
This branch provides an executable cafe cashflow reference and verified UI behavior for the active A1/A2/A3 lane owners. It starts from the public-data commit and is a draft integration reference; its root package/Docker files must be reconciled with the current TypeScript scaffold before merging.

The workbench preserves zero versus missing inputs, seeded scenario reproducibility, request snapshots, out-of-order response protection and a fresh human decision per run. Gemini proposals use a server-only key and fail clearly when no key is configured.

Validation: 6/6 repository tests, 10/10 independent arithmetic/HTTP/provider-mock checks, and actual desktop/mobile Chrome checks passed. Provider tests were mocks. Live Gemini calls, Cloud deployment, calibration, main acceptance gates and the full production workflow remain unverified.

Important contract differences: the reference keeps the deposit locked through month 36, while main returns it in the final month; it uses constant numeric assumption variations rather than structural design patches; its cash-positive transaction boundary is not the main rank-flip cliff. See docs/INTEGRATION_NOTES.md for the exact adapter requirements. Preserve the frozen shared contract and verifier-owned tests.
